latestVersion.changelog:
SkillBoss v0.1.0 initial release

- Introduces a multi-AI gateway for building/deploying full-stack apps on Cloudflare Workers, featuring DB (D1/KV/R2), Stripe payments, auth, and AI media generation.
- One-click trial key provisioning from CLI; permanent keys via browser signup.
- Full support for major workflows: website/app deployment, e-commerce, SaaS, AI-generated media, emailing, web search, document processing, SMS, and more.
- "Pilot" command lets users discover, select, and auto-run any AI model (50+ LLMs and modalities) with easy CLI flags.
- Enforces update requirements: auto-check for mandatory updates after every API call, halting if required.
- Session-based workflow for trial keys including first-request prompts and upgrade flow.
